newsitem.title: USA: Cytyc sees Q4 revs level with Q3.
newsitem.headline: Cytyc sees Q4 revs level with Q3.

text.p: Cytyc Corp said on Wednesday it expected revenues in the fourth quarter to be roughly equal to third quarter revenue levels, as the company increases sales and marketing to penetrate the U.S. market.

The company, which develops, makes and markets the ThinPrep system for medical diagnostic applications, also said it expected full commercial launch of its ThinPrep Pap Test in the United States in the first quarter of 1997.
Cytyc said future revenues would continue to depend on the acceptance and reimbursement rate of the ThinPrep Pap Test by third party payors, clinical laboratories and physicians.
In the third quarter 1996, Cytyc reported sales of $2.7 million, compared to $887,000 in the same period last year.

Cytyc President and Chief Executive Officer Patrick Sullivan attributed the rise to increased sales of ThinPrep instruments, disposable kits for non-gynecological tests and initial ThinPrep Pap Tests shipments in both the United States and Australia.
He said expenses also increased because of ThinPrep Pap Test system test marketing efforts.
